title: FileDeleteCompleted
description: Result: a file under watch_dir was deleted, in reply to a FileDeleteRequested (Design.md §13 Step F4). eventDetails.correlationId is set to that request's eventId. If the file didn't exist, FileOperationFailed is published instead — not this event.

path.description: File path, relative to watch_dir, that was deleted.

occurredAt.description: UTC timestamp (RFC 3339 / ISO 8601) the delete completed.
